answer: In PoA, each identity—whether tagged raven, island, or sonnet—must complete a Wesolowski VDF: a chain of sequential modular squarings in an unknown-order group, followed by a succinct proof. Because each square depends on the preceding result, distributing one chain across GPUs cannot reduce its inherent elapsed time. Cloning identities only multiplies these physical delays and hardware costs, enforcing a deadline-bound sybil barrier.
